summary: ansible-core 2.16.20 backports several warnings, mostly deprecations, from 2.19 and later to give advance notice to people upgrading across several releases; most can be disabled with deprecation_warnings=False.
questions: Why am I seeing new deprecation warnings after a 2.16 patch update?
How do I turn off deprecation warnings in ansible.cfg?
What are the backported 2.19 warnings for?

answer_card.title: Backported 2.19 warnings in 2.16.20
answer_card.answer_md:
ansible-core **2.16.20** backports warnings from 2.19+ (mostly deprecations) so you can fix content before a multi-release upgrade. Most can be silenced with:

```ini
[defaults]
deprecation_warnings = False
```

Better: fix each case as described in the following sections.
